name: Narusaki Momiji
source:
Class: 2-B
Favorite food: Cat-shaped omurice
Hobbies: Crossword puzzles, taking care of the protagonist
Troubles: She's a bad cook, can't beat the protagonist in studying, can't watch horror movies alone and her period always starts late after having sex.

[url=/c78241]Yuuya[/url]'s childhood friend and neighbor whom she also shared her first kiss with when they were younger. Though they're the same age, Momiji was born only a few days earlier. Due to both of their parents often going outseas, their parents leave Momiji to take care of him. She joined the cooking club in order to become a better cook.

She is good friends with both [url=/c8471]Eruru[/url] and [url=/c8472]Hikari[/url].
